description: Land Title Settlement Department - Horetuduwa, Panadura D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530011
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extent measurements, owner names and addresses, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content is entirely focused on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements.
